comment: With optimizer and budget identical (AdamW, nominal Δ=.01536), normalization and signal propagation drove the ranking. A’s three normalized blocks, including the terminal block, led; C’s shallower residual architecture with two normalized blocks followed. E retained two normalization sites but lacked terminal normalization; D had only one, and B combined one early normalization site with a deep nonresidual SiLU stack. K1009, K1015, and K1022 helped frame these as conditional architecture preferences rather than deterministic scores. K1016 discouraged ranking by width alone. This result supports the full architectural ordering on this instance, but does not isolate normalization count, placement, or residual effects.
